metadata.case_name: LEE TAT HUNG v. AMIGO ENTERPRISES LTD

injuries.description: the Plaintiff suffered a severe injury to his right eye.
source: the Plaintiff suffered a severe injury to his right eye.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of eye or orbit, unspecified

injuries.description: Due to the injury, he developed a cataract which was surgically removed in September 1981.
source: Due to the injury, he developed a cataract which was surgically removed in September 1981.

injuries.description: the eye has lost the flexibility associated with a normal eye with a normal lens.
source: the eye has lost the flexibility associated with a normal eye with a normal lens.

manifestations.description: with the aid of a corneal contact lens, distance vision is corrected to near normal.
"....despite his age he is unable to automatically change his focus from a distance (sic) to a near object. As a consequence, the Right Eye requires a spectacle lens for reading."

treatments_received: treatment at the Yaumatei Ophthalmic Clinic

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Reduced ability to read, watch television, participate in sport, drive a motor vehicle (items to be considered under the head of loss of amenities).
The defect would make it difficult for the Plaintiff to continue in his employment as a watch repair technician.

comparable_cases.case_name: Fok Shu Woon v. Katherine Peon Ling Yee
comparable_cases.injury_description: Ruptured left eyeball treated; later developed a cataract; had lost the sight of his left eye but there was a chance of regaining some sight with operation and contact lenses; loss of ability to focus automatically; eye subject to irritations such as itchiness and glare. Residual disability assessed between 25% to 30%.
